summary: A json-document kind reads the directory / starred-segment identity its kind declares, instead of refusing the shape emit already places

edit.description: `DocumentMember::parse`'s identity match (src/json_manifest.rs:230-250) serves `UnitShape::Directory` and `UnitShape::StarredSegment` off the source path through the one hoisted derivation, as the frontmatter face does; `JsonManifestError::NoDeclaredIdentity` (line 325) and the `# Errors` sentence naming it (line 201) retire — once every declared shape is served there is no shape left to refuse. The variant has no consumer outside this file and the one test named below (`rg NoDeclaredIdentity`).

`Member::from_source_rooted`'s `Directory` arm (lines 185-199) and `StarredSegment` arm (lines 209-218) call the hoisted derivation rather than spelling it inline, so the path-shaped identity has one home and the two faces cannot come to disagree about it (`specs/process/engineering.md`, "One job, one home"). `fold_file_id` and the `NamedField` arms are untouched — the named-field read is per-format by construction (frontmatter mapping vs top-level JSON key).

The hoisted derivation's home, beside `source_dir_name` (src/extract.rs:812) that the starred-segment half already calls — keeping it here means json_manifest gains no dependency on the frontmatter adapter to read a path fact.
`a_json_document_kind_declaring_a_path_shaped_identity_refuses_loud` (line 158) inverts into the two reads it used to refuse, and gains the inbox's reported seam shape end to end.

tests.asserts: a directory-shaped `json-document` kind reads its id off the owning directory name and a starred-segment one off the starred segment, identically to the frontmatter face over the same paths; and the seam closes — a kind at `{ at, root: "docs", glob: "*/area.json" }`, `json-document`, `unitShape: directory`, with a nested file child templated at `*/page.json`, emits every member to its derived path and then loads at check with no `identity shape it cannot serve` refusal

acceptance: cargo test green with the refusal test replaced by the two reads plus the emit-then-check seam; `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean with `JsonManifestError::NoDeclaredIdentity` gone.
notes: Routed from the inbox note observed at fca7b4f9, re-verified at HEAD: the refusal still stands (src/json_manifest.rs:243) and emit's half is format-blind — `placement_in_unit` (src/drift.rs:1129) branches on `unit_shape` alone, so emit places what check refuses. `toml-document` keeps its named-field-only narrowness: a read face with no write twin, so emit refuses such a member whole and the two sides cannot disagree. scoped at 43541de0
